observation: A capture hooks all 42 calls of the resident file read entry 800295d8 on the frozen route (field, battle, post-battle and return loads in modes 0, 80 and 100). From each original entry image the shared C++ Program reproduces the exact exit image and return value of 39 calls; three calls made while the previous read is still in progress stop explicitly at the idle wait 80028a60, which only an interrupt can end. Three of the 39 changed interrupt-owned bytes in the unbracketed capture; each matches exactly in a recapture with interrupt brackets.
interpretation: File-table lookup, size rounding, directory selection, stream-ring selection and reset, read-request state, CD position conversion, DMA and ready callbacks, the CD control entry and its no-wait command writer run as recovered source. Register writes are recorded as ordered disc-service commands; reads of controller state come only from the observed I/O page. This covers every disc read issued on the frozen route up to the controller boundary; sector delivery and completion interrupts remain service-side.
author: Claude Opus 5.5, integration owner
reviewers: Independent instruction-level review of the read chain, libcd-level control and command writer, ownership extents and the disc idle wait (review-disc-read.md): no blocking defects; the harness now attaches a stream ring only when its header lies in RAM.

preconditions: Pinned Nix environment and original Disc 1 profile; frozen route input tests/reference-inputs/field23-encounter-observation.json; observation core parity 1.7.1.

commands: nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop path:./nix -c python3 -m tools.analysis.memory_case --capture .local/scenarios/phase1-field23-disc-reads{,-a,-b,-c}-20260923-v5/capture --runner RUNNER --entry disc_read_file --entry-hook read-entry --exit-hook read-exit [--interrupt tick-entry:tick-exit --interrupt dispatch-entry:dispatch-exit] --report REPORT
validation.expected: Exact exit image and return value, or an explicit stop at an interrupt-dependent wait.
validation.actual: Full route: 36 exact, 3 interrupt-attributable divergences in the unbracketed capture, 3 explicit waits; the three divergent calls each match exactly with interrupt brackets. Unit tests cover modes 0, 80, 100 and 200, the -3/-4 returns and every explicit failure.
validation.tolerance: None beyond the documented interrupt attribution.

limitations: Recorded controller and DMA register writes are verified by synthetic tests only.
Waits that need a completion interrupt, the host-file branch, debug prints and timeouts fail explicitly.
Per-call equivalence; sector delivery and CD interrupts are not reconstructed.
